activities.title: Blood Donation Camp
activities.description: A student-led blood donation drive conducted with district health officials and college medical support.
activities.organizers: NSS Unit and SRGEC Health Cell

activities.title: Swachh Bharat Campus Drive
activities.description: Cleanliness awareness campaign and campus beautification activity inspired by Swachh Bharat Abhiyan.

activities.title: Tree Plantation Drive
activities.description: Native sapling plantation and awareness campaign for sustainable campus development.

activities.title: Awareness Rally
activities.description: A campus-to-community awareness rally on road safety, public health, and youth responsibility.
activities.organizers: NSS Programme Officer and Student Coordinators

activities.title: Village Education Campaign
activities.description: Awareness sessions on digital literacy, career guidance, and community health for nearby village students.

activities.title: Community Health Camp
activities.description: Basic health screening, hygiene awareness, and first-aid guidance for local residents.
activities.organizers: NSS Unit with local health workers

camps.name: National Integration Camp (NIC)
camps.authority: Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports
camps.description: A national camp focused on unity, cultural exchange, discipline, youth leadership, group discussion, community living, cultural presentation, and inter-state volunteer interaction.

camps.name: National Youth Festival
camps.description: A youth festival celebrating leadership, culture, innovation, national service, youth dialogue, social awareness exhibitions, and university representation.

camps.name: Adventure Camp
camps.description: Leadership training through trekking, team tasks, first-aid drills, outdoor resilience activities, discipline sessions, and personality development.

camps.name: University Special Camp
camps.description: Seven-day residential camp with rural outreach, sanitation work, education support, health awareness, household surveys, and volunteer leadership responsibilities.

camps.name: State NSS Camp
camps.description: State-level leadership camp for selected NSS volunteers from affiliated colleges, including parade practice, cultural exchange, NSS reporting, and service planning.

camps.name: Special Camp
camps.description: Residential camp focused on sanitation, education, village survey, public awareness programs, school visits, clean drinking water awareness, and evening cultural sessions.

camps.name: Pre-Republic Day Parade Camp
camps.description: Selection-oriented camp with parade training, physical fitness, cultural screening, discipline evaluation, and leadership assessment for Republic Day camp consideration.

camps.name: Mega Blood Donation Service Camp
camps.authority: SRGEC NSS Unit with District Medical Team
camps.description: One-day service camp for blood donor registration, donor awareness, medical coordination, volunteer desk management, and emergency response support.
